description: Listed Waste Company Summary is a dataset listed in Northern Territory Government open data portal (data.nt.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment Protection Authority. A summary list is available to assist in identifying what companies are licensed to handle what type of listed waste(s) and how (e. g. collect, transport, store, treat, recycle or dispose) they are licensed to handle the listed waste. Coverage: Northern Territory. The portal files it under the publisher Environment Protection Authority. Its tags are Environment, Waste. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2025-04-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-nt-government-open-data-portal.
